voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Approximate target projected section size in render pixels. Smaller = finer terrain and more work; larger = coarser terrain and less work. Zooming still increases detail. GPU memory may limit the requested quality. This is not the width of an individual block.
voxy.config.general.geometry_memory.tool: Controls how much GPU memory Voxy can use for LOD geometry. Larger values allow more detailed LODs to stay loaded, but consequently reduce FPS. The default is selected automatically for your GPU; unsafe sizes are hidden.
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: The mode used for screenspace ambient occlusion (Auto attempts to pick the best option while reducing performance impact)
voxy.config.general.adaptCloudDistance.t: Enables or disables adaptive cloud distance
voxy.config.general.cloudDistance.toolti: Cloud distance in chunks (Only used if adaptive cloud distance is disabled)
voxy.config.general.fogIntensity.tooltip: Intensity of the fog, higher values make the fog thicker and reduce visibility
voxy.config.general.fogDensity.tooltip: Density of the fog, higher values make the fog thicker
voxy.config.general.skyFogDistance.toolt: Distance at which sky fog starts to render in chunks
voxy.config.streaming.update_interval.to: Minimum time between background terrain update batches. Cached terrain stays visible; missing terrain and zoom detail bypass this interval.
voxy.config.streaming.bandwidth.tooltip: Maximum total Voxy download traffic for %s across all dimensions, including handshakes, terrain, QUIC retransmissions and IP/UDP overhead. Decimal kbps/Mbps. The cap applies to missing terrain, detail preparation and updates.
voxy.config.streaming.storage.tooltip: Terrain cache allowance for %s across all dimensions, including complete cache files and metadata. Decimal MB/GB. Entire world keeps all existing saved terrain when disk space permits. At a full disk, new downloads pause and cached terrain remains available.
voxy.config.streaming.no_server: Join a multiplayer server to set its download bandwidth and cache storage.
